CREATE TABLE "public"."pv_categoria_servicio" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "codigo" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "descripcion" character varying(500),
  "id_categoria_servicio" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombre" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "orden" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_categoria_servicio")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pv_disponibilidad_proveedor" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "disponible" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "fecha" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "hora_fin" time,
  "hora_inicio" time,
  "id_disponibilidad_proveedor" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_proveedor" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_proveedor_servicio" int4,
  "observacion" character varying(1000),
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_disponibilidad_proveedor")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pv_matrimonio_proveedor" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "estado_seleccion" text DEFAULT 'CONSIDERADO' NOT NULL,
  "favorito" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id_matrimonio" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_matrimonio_proveedor" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_proveedor" uuid NOT NULL,
  "observaciones" character varying(1000),
  "prioridad" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_matrimonio_proveedor"),
  CONSTRAINT "pv_matrimonio_proveedor_estado_seleccion_check_4a0eb630" CHECK ("estado_seleccion" IN ('CONSIDERADO', 'SELECCIONADO', 'DESCARTADO')),
  CONSTRAINT "pv_matrimonio_proveedor_prioridad_check_7fdb94e2" CHECK ("prioridad" IN ('ALTA', 'MEDIA', 'BAJA'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pv_proveedor" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "correo_contacto" character varying(150),
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "descripcion" character varying(1000),
  "direccion" character varying(250),
  "id_entidad" int4,
  "id_persona_natural" int4,
  "id_proveedor" uuid NOT NULL,
  "instagram" character varying(150),
  "nombre_comercial" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "observaciones" character varying(1000),
  "sitio_web" character varying(250),
  "telefono_contacto" character varying(15),
  "tipo_proveedor" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "whatsapp" character varying(15),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_proveedor"),
  CONSTRAINT "pv_proveedor_tipo_proveedor_check_f441b683" CHECK ("tipo_proveedor" IN ('PERSONA_NATURAL', 'EMPRESA'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pv_proveedor_servicio" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "costo_referencial" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "descripcion" character varying(1000),
  "id_categoria_servicio" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id_proveedor" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_proveedor_servicio" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "moneda" text DEFAULT 'PEN' NOT NULL,
  "nombre" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "unidad_precio" character varying(50),
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_proveedor_servicio"),
  CONSTRAINT "pv_proveedor_servicio_moneda_check_5b6558d3" CHECK ("moneda" IN ('PEN', 'USD'))
)
